CustomField.description: This formula field will return TRUE if the exclusion is applied for a patron. This can be be verified by checking Patron status.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( Patron_Status__c = "External Exclusion-Group Wide", Patron_Status__c = "WOL - Entire Property", Patron_Status__c = "Venue - Group Wide", Patron_Status__c = "Self - Exclusion", Patron_Status__c = "Excluded QLD", Patron_Status__c = "Excluded ALL", Patron_Status__c = "Self - CCA, Wagering & Keno", Patron_Status__c = "Venue - CCA", Patron_Status__c = "TP7DAY", Patron_Status__c = "Problem", Patron_Status__c = "WOL - Property Exclusion", Patron_Status__c = "Venue - Exclusions", Patron_Status__c = "Excluded NSW", Patron_Status__c = "Venue - Exclusion", Patron_Status__c = "Problem - Group Wide", Patron_Status__c = "Self Exclusion - QLD", Patron_Status__c = "Prob Gambling", Patron_Status__c = "Self Exclusion - NSW", Patron_Status__c = "Problem Gambling - Group Wide", Patron_Status__c = "TP24HR", Patron_Status__c = "Problem Gambling", Patron_Status__c = "WOL - Group Wide", Patron_Status__c = "WOL - Property - Group Wide" ), TRUE, FALSE )
CustomField.label: is Excluded
